name: Can I change my kitchen layout when replacing my cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can I change my kitchen layout when replacing my cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing cabinets is the best opportunity to alter your kitchen layout, add an island, or relocate appliances. However, shifting appliances requires trade coordination. Moving a dishwasher or sink requires licensed plumbing work, while relocating a refrigerator or range demands electrical modifications. HH Remodeling provides custom framing, drywall repair, and finish carpentry in-house while coordinating the necessary trade subcontractors, keeping the entire layout reconfiguration under a single point of contact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. You can redesign your layout or add an island, provided plumbing and electrical lines are updated by coordinated trades to match the new cabinet design.
